examples.swap_sentence: The build passes agora, mas the cache is stale, então I cleared it.

sense_notes.brief: para never after ask, wait, look or pay, or for a duration; então only for therefore or then, never the intensifier so, which is tão; aqui only for a place, never here's; mais means more, never and; depois de and antes de before a noun; o tempo is time or weather, a vez an occasion, o time a team; atualmente means currently, a pasta a folder, a data a date, legal cool; não only as an answer; tem only for there is; the article a reads as English a, so use a nouns where the English had the
sense_notes.export: para only for purpose or recipient, never after ask, wait, look or pay (pedir, esperar, procurar and pagar take no "for"), and never for a duration; então is "so" meaning therefore, or "then", but "so" as an intensifier is tão; aqui only for a place, never "here's"; mais means "more", never "and" or "plus" (mas is "but"); depois and antes alone mean afterwards and earlier, and before a noun they are depois de and antes de; o tempo is time or the weather, a vez an occasion (the first time), a hora clock time, and o time a sports team; false friends: atualmente is currently (actually is na verdade), a pasta a folder, a data a date (data is os dados), legal cool; ainda alone is still, and "not yet" is the whole ainda não; tem is there is or there are, not has; não only as the answer no; the feminine article a reads as English "a", so use those nouns where the English had "the"
sense_notes.export_short: para not after ask/wait or for durations; mais = more; atualmente = currently

extension.sense_note: "so" meaning therefore -> então; "so" as an intensifier, as in "so slow", is tão, NOT então; "here" introducing something, as in "here's", is NOT aqui; "actually" is NOT atualmente; "and" or "plus" is NOT mais; a noun listed with the article a reads as English "a", so swap it only where the English had "the"
